rtl_snippet: always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrst_n) begin

fix.rationale:
STRATEGY: RETIME (latency-preserving; added_latency_cycles = 0).

PATH READING. Startpoint _124902_ is a cycle_counter bit (uart_rx.v:170, p_cycle_counter). Cells 1-8 (NOR4/NAND4/OAI22/NOR2/AOI211/AND3/AND3/NAND3 = 0.62 ns of the 0.94 ns) are the two wide equality compares of cycle_counter against CYCLES_PER_BIT and CYCLES_PER_BIT/2 that form next_bit, ANDed with fsm_state==FSM_STOP to form uart_rx_valid. Cells 9-13 (XOR2/XOR2/XOR2/NOR3 = 0.24 ns) are the binary->gray increment and the full compare in wptr_full, driven by winc = uart_rx_valid. The dominant delay is therefore inside my scope: uart_rx_valid is a purely combinational output that exports the whole comparator cone into the FIFO pointer logic.

WHERE THE MOVE WAS MADE. The comparator cone for uart_rx_valid is retimed backwards across the fsm_state / cycle_counter registers. valid(T) = fsm(T)==STOP && (cc(T)==CPB || cc(T)==CPB/2). fsm(T)==STOP arises only from fsm(T-1)==RECV && payload_done, or fsm(T-1)==STOP && !next_bit; in both of those cases the counter is enabled and not cleared, so cc(T) = cc(T-1)+1 and the tests become cc(T-1)==CPB-1 / cc(T-1)==CPB/2-1 — constant-shifted compares taken straight off the counter register, so no incrementer is pulled onto the new path. The one remaining sub-case (fsm==RECV && payload_done && next_bit) clears the counter to 0, which matches neither constant, and neither _m1 term can be asserted there, so the expression is exactly 0 then too. The result is captured in uart_rx_valid_q, which now drives the port directly. The output asserts in the identical cycle with the identical value; only the boundary flop moved.

TIMING EFFECT. New intra-module path: cycle_counter -> 4 parallel constant compares -> 2 levels of AND/OR -> uart_rx_valid_q (~0.45 ns, shorter than the 0.62 ns it replaces and it no longer crosses the module boundary). New cross-module path: uart_rx_valid_q clk-to-Q -> the 4-gate gray/compare chain in wptr_full (~0.32 ns). The reported path is cut roughly in half.

RECONVERGENCE. uart_rx_valid fans out inside this module only to uart_rx_break (= valid && ~|recieved_data); since valid holds the same value in the same cycle, break is bit-identical and no re-balancing is needed. uart_rx_data is loaded from recieved_data on every cycle in which fsm_state==FSM_STOP, so it is already stable in the cycle valid asserts — unchanged. next_bit, the FSM, both counters and bit_sample keep their original combinational definitions (cc_eq_half is only a named alias of the existing cycle_counter==CYCLES_PER_BIT/2 compare, same expression, now shared).

WHY NOT THE OTHERS. PIPELINE: registering uart_rx_valid without the one-cycle-earlier evaluation would delay the FIFO write by a cycle relative to uart_rx_data and to the receiver's return to FSM_IDLE, i.e. it changes observable behaviour and would require re-balancing logic in wptr_full, which is outside my scope. RESTRUCTURE alone: the comparator network is already a balanced constant-equality tree (NOR4/NAND4 of a 14-bit value); flattening it would need wider, slower gates and would still leave the whole cone plus the FIFO gray chain in one cycle — not enough to recover 0.02 ns plus margin. NO_FIX: rejected because the dominant 0.62 ns clearly is in this module's comparator logic.
